PPTX presentation extraction using extract

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pptx/simple.pptx\"}")
    result = await extract(input)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
